name: fetch-requests-in-hooks-need-timeouts
hook: Fetch requests in useEffect hooks must have AbortController timeout
body: Fetch requests in useEffect hooks (like useCurrentUser.fetchUser) can hang indefinitely if the server doesn't respond, causing isLoading to stay true forever and showing a loading spinner forever. Fix: Use AbortController with setTimeout to abort the request after a reasonable timeout (e.g., 30s).
why: Issue #2571 manifested as /admin/chat stuck on 'Loading...' because the fetch to /api/users/me had no timeout. The same pattern was used in #2570 for RecentTransactionsWidget and MetricsProvider.
